```{r}
library(googlesheets4)
library(dplyr)

# We don't need to pass credentials to googlesheets since the sheet is publicly available.
gs4_deauth()

# Expected columns: Post, Title, Date, Location, Description
events <- read_sheet(
  "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1escqpJM_Ljt5h5claM0xV5e9IEWBv6rNMIsuQsnUXYY/edit?gid=0#gid=0"
) |>
  filter(Post %in% c("Conference", "Workshop")) |>
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(Date),
    Location = paste(City, Country, sep = ", ")
  )

# TODO: this should be removed, it's just for demo purposes
events <- bind_rows(
  events,
  tibble(
    Post = "Workshop",
    Date = as.Date("2026-11-25"),
    Title = "Palaeoverse workshop at IPC",
    Location = "Cape Town, South Africa",
    Link = "https://google.com"
  ),
  tibble(
    Post = "Hackathon",
    Date = as.Date("2026-11-30"),
    Title = "Hackathon for demo",
    Location = "Somewhere",
    Link = "https://google.com"
  )
)


today <- Sys.Date()

future_events <- events |> filter(Date >= today) |> arrange(Date)
past_events <- events |> filter(Date < today) |> arrange(desc(Date))

type_to_css <- function(type) {
  switch(
    tolower(type),
    "workshop" = "event-workshop",
    "conference" = "event-conference",
    "hackathon" = "event-hackathon",
    "lecture series" = "event-lecture",
    stop("The event type should be one of the types above.")
  )
}

render_cards <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(knitr::asis_output("<p><em>No events to display.</em></p>"))
  }
  parts <- '<div class="event-grid">'
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
    row <- df[i, ]
    css <- type_to_css(row$Post)
    date_str <- format(row$Date, "%B %d, %Y")
    has_link <- !is.na(row$Link) && nzchar(row$Link)
    inner <- sprintf(
      '<div class="event-card %s"><span class="event-tag">%s</span><h3>%s</h3><p class="event-date">%s · %s</p></div>',
      css,
      row$Post,
      row$Title,
      date_str,
      row$Location
    )
    if (has_link) {
      parts <- c(
        parts,
        sprintf(
          '<a href="%s" target="_blank" class="event-link">%s</a>',
          row$Link,
          inner
        )
      )
    } else {
      parts <- c(parts, inner)
    }
  }
  parts <- c(parts, "</div>")
  knitr::asis_output(paste(parts, collapse = "\n"))
}
```

**DEV NOTES:** I manually added one of our workshops (with likely wrong details) to the list so that "Future
events" isn't empty.

## Future events

```{r}
render_cards(future_events)
```

## Past events

```{r}
render_cards(past_events)
```
